Question: Can a narcissist truly love their girlfriend or spouse?
Answer: A narcissist does not truly love you. Despite what you may have heard, they don't even love what you can do for them. A narcissist loves what they can do to you. When a narcissist idealizes you, what they are really seeing is a perfect target to hurt, blame, and punish. Narcissists are full of negative, harmful thoughts - constantly plotting and planning how they can bring other people down. The narcissist needs to release all this negativity onto someone who is willing to take it, someone naive, forgiving, and extremely tolerant. You see someone who can give you perfect love, but the narcissist sees someone they can perfectly abuse. Narcissists don't have empathy. Question: How soon does a narcissist usually get bored of a new supply?
Answer: Once you, as the supply, start noticing problems and try to fix them in the relationship, things change. At first, everything was about the narcissist’s obsession with you. As long as you did everything they wanted without any complaints, the honeymoon phase continued. Narcissists crave attention because it distracts them from their boredom. However, their need for attention is often unrealistic and unhealthy. Even if they devalue you, as long as you don’t complain, they won’t get bored. Narcissists get bored when you start resisting their wishes or challenging them. This irritates them and leads to them devaluing you, and sometimes even seeking other partners. So, if you keep meeting their demands without complaints, they won’t get bored. But as soon as you start pushing back, trouble begins, and their boredom sets in. To a narcissist, you’re just a source of supply to fill the emptiness in their life. How long they stay interested really depends on how long you keep up the honeymoon phase. This is really important. If you don’t have anyone like this, try joining support groups in your community through places like Elizabeth Fry Society, John Howard, or a local church. 3. Express your feelings through writing, painting, or drawing. Find a way to release your pain. You’ll have a lot of it, so if you haven’t found an outlet before, now’s the time to try. Give it time. If you follow these steps, the feelings will fade with time. Question: What does ignoring the narcissist really do to them?

They think their self-worth is tied to how much attention they can get from you and others. When a narcissist is being ignored, they can become more aggressive. They may lose their temper and lash out or send demanding messages, trying to force you to talk to them. They'll never admit they did anything wrong or try to discuss it with you.
